# LengthInput

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Every form a single measurement may be written as in a public authoring position:

- `72` - points, the canonical unit
- `'1in'` · `'10mm'` · `'2.5cm'` · `'72pt'` - a unit-suffixed token
- `{ value: 1, unit: Unit.Inch }` - value plus enum, for computed units

Lengths normalise to points on write and read back as a plain `number`, so engine code never sees a unit.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type LengthInput = number | LengthToken | LengthObject
```
